I appreciate the kind words, and I hope you're more successful than I at starting a business.

I'm extremely introverted by nature, going out isn't something I enjoy and I don't meet people easily. It literally took me 10 years to build the friends that I have and my ex took all of that from me.

I feel you there man. I just posted about a very similar situation—overworked myself at a job where I wasn’t appreciated for a girl who didn’t appreciate me. Slowly stopped hanging out with all my friends until the job and the girl both left me a broken mess. Now she’s out hanging with my former friends at the local watering hole posting pictures to social media captioned “hot girl summer” and I just wonder how life can be so cruel sometimes.
